cases.input: A business model advances to a successor release on a channel-economics change while the strategy choice set and the value-stream stage sequence are unchanged.
cases.expect: Only the business model versions; the other roots stay at their current versions and are linked by a WM-ACT-024 and WM-REC-010 reference.
cases.violates: none (exercises: A successor release of one root never compels a successor release of another.)

cases.input: The profile artifact declares decision REUSE_BY_REFERENCE, referencedBases limited to the admitted five, baseLevelConstraints empty and baseSpecificationState non-canonical-draft.
cases.expect: The artifact is accepted as reference-only reuse with no restriction asserted over any base.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Objectives, initiatives and decisions retain their own masters.)

cases.input: A candidate whose every reference target is in the admitted or legacy set is evaluated against the extended policy.
cases.expect: The candidate passes the admittedReferenceTargets check.
cases.violates: none (exercises: Blocked referents are never silently promoted.)

cases.input: Each candidate declares digest algorithm sha-256, RFC 8785 canonicalization and a scope excluding the contentDigest field, and a released version is re-digested unchanged.
cases.expect: The digest recomputes identically and the immutability check passes.

cases.input: A migrated fixture file declares fixtureShapeVersion v2 and every case carries id, target, kind, input, expect, violates and closesDefect, with expectedCode on every negative.
cases.expect: The fixture file passes the shape check.

cases.input: A candidate is submitted with a non-null modelId or registryId, or with allocationState other than unassigned.
cases.expect: The candidate is rejected; no identifier may be allocated or guessed in this contour.
cases.violates: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.

cases.input: Retirement of a scenario version is propagated to retire the strategy, business model and value stream that cited it.
cases.expect: The propagation is rejected; scenario retirement never retires another root.
cases.violates: A successor release of one root never compels a successor release of another.

cases.input: A rule requires that every business-model successor release also force a strategy successor release and a shared baseline across both.
cases.expect: The rule is rejected; roots version on their own change drivers and share no baseline.
cases.violates: A successor release of one root never compels a successor release of another.

cases.input: An effective strategy release is edited in place to change an excluded choice, and contentDigest is recomputed over the new content.
cases.expect: The edit is rejected; change proceeds only by successor release with a supersession link.

cases.input: A contentDigest is computed over the release object including the contentDigest field itself, with no canonicalization declared.
cases.expect: The digest is rejected; the declared scope excludes the digest field and canonicalization is mandatory.

cases.input: A fixture case carries only id, kind, input and expect, and a negative case carries no expectedCode.
cases.expect: The fixture file is rejected until every case carries target, violates and closesDefect, and every negative carries expectedCode.

cases.input: A validation policy omits admittedReferenceTargets and unadmittedReferenceTargetsMustBeNull, and a candidate carrying five unadmitted referents passes it.
cases.expect: The policy is rejected as insufficient; the allowlist and null rule are mandatory.
cases.violates: Blocked referents are never silently promoted.

cases.input: A candidate is submitted with canonicalPublishable true and empty holds, and the policy accepts it.
cases.expect: Both the candidate and the policy are rejected; canonicalPublishable must be false and holds non-empty.
cases.violates: Registry allocation is pending and no identifier may be guessed.

cases.input: The artifact declares decision PROFILE over the five admitted bases while listing only constraints that bind the new candidates, and asserts a restriction on WM-ACT-030.
cases.expect: The artifact is rejected; without a stated base-level constraint the decision is reuse by reference, and no restriction may be asserted over a non-canonical draft base.
cases.violates: Objectives, initiatives and decisions retain their own masters.

cases.input: An artifact or report asserts canonical completeness, installability or publication readiness for any EM-STR-01 candidate.
cases.expect: The assertion is rejected; no such claim is admissible while allocation, crosswalk, mastership confirmation and relationship contracts are outstanding.
cases.violates: Package conversion and live verification are pending.
